Hi Samantha — great to talk earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can get the customer-led load test scheduled: 

Summary of what we heard: 
- Target SLO: P95 latency <= 300ms for standard text-generation routes (non-streaming).
- Throughput: sustained ~500 req/s, concurrency ~200 concurrent sessions, burst up to ~1,200 req/s for short spikes.
- Streaming: one route will use chunked streaming (server-sent events); needs to keep per-chunk latency <150ms and total end-to-end stability.

Proposed next steps from Redwood: 
1) You share the k6/Locust scripts you plan to run (or we can use the script attached to our plan).
2) Confirm test window (we suggested Apr 20 00:00-04:00 UTC; open to alternatives).
3) Provide test accounts and IP ranges to allowlist (we'll need a short-lived API token tied to the test account).
4) We'll provision a dedicated test token and temporary scaling config; Aditya (cc'd) will handle infra prep and logging.

Can you confirm the window and attach the script you plan to run? If you want, we can also run a quick smoke test earlier in a small window to validate tokens and allowlists.

Thanks — looking forward to coordinating.

— Logan
